speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To determine the cause, have you noticed any fever or chills alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID). The patient's age, sexual history with inconsistent condom use, and symptoms of lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria are classic for a sexually transmitted infection ascending to the upper genital tract. Immediate evaluation and treatment are required.
